findings.summary: Tessaline achieves higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 ± 0.6 vs 27.6 ± 0.8 over 8 seeds), but no statistical test is reported for this comparison, so the difference is not established as significant.
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, BLEU, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: No significance test reported for Tessaline vs Varrow-NMT; difference in means only.

findings.summary: Tessaline significantly outperforms PhraseGrid in BLEU on the same test set, with a mean paired difference of 6.35 BLEU points (95% CI [5.87, 6.83], p < 0.001, paired t-test, n=8).
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, BLEU, 8 paired seeds
findings.caveats: Comparison is to a phrase-based baseline, not to Varrow-NMT.

findings.summary: Tessaline also shows higher mean chrF than both Varrow-NMT and PhraseGrid (58.1 ± 0.8 vs 57.7 ± 0.5 and 52.4 ± 0.5), but no statistical tests are reported for these chrF differences.
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, chrF, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: No significance tests reported for chrF comparisons.
